title: Editor E0 task 10: one per-type block limit replaces the six dedupe sets, so two Text blocks coexist and a second Offerings is refused
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19 (owner: "Fan out and start building everything"; ADR-1325 sequence: 9 → 10 → 11). lib/entity-blocks/block-limits.ts holds the one policy, ported from lib/page-editor/block-limits.ts: a data block appears once per document, a design block (DESIGN_ENTITY_BLOCK_IDS) three times, every other content block without limit. typeLimiter() returns a per-document admit(id) predicate and the six former dedupe sites call it: rows-ops normalize, layout parseRows, sanitizeRows, sanitizeEntityLayout, mergeEntityLayout and resolveRows. mergeEntityLayout keeps a presence set only so a fresh default id is appended when the author placed none of that type. components/entity-blocks/entity-grid.tsx keys each block by position so two siblings of one type never collide. block-limits.test.ts proves the §8 gate at every site; rows-ops.test.ts and layout.test.ts pin that a data block still lands once. Still keyed by type until task 11: a legacy document's content and style bags (two Text blocks share one bag) and hidden. No editor exposes a duplicate yet (pickers offer palette minus placed; placeBlock moves by id); that is task 12.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const b=r('lib/entity-blocks/block-limits.ts');if(!/export function typeLimiter/.test(b)||!/export function entityBlockLimit/.test(b))bad.push('no per-type policy');const l=r('lib/entity-blocks/layout.ts');const o=r('lib/entity-blocks/rows-ops.ts');if((l.match(/typeLimiter\(\)/g)||[]).length<5)bad.push('layout.ts sites do not all read the limiter');if(!/typeLimiter\(\)/.test(o))bad.push('normalize does not read the limiter');if(/const seen = new Set<string>\(\)|const seenBlocks = new Set<string>\(\)|const placed = new Set<string>\(\)/.test(l+o))bad.push('a dedupe set is back');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-960: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the policy module is gone, when a former dedupe site stops reading typeLimiter(), or when a global seen set returns. The two-text-two-offerings gate at each site is lib/entity-blocks/block-limits.test.ts, in the test job (a row probe may not spawn a test runner, LIVE-034).
